blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Photos from sources show the office vacated by Sen. Jinggoy Estrada as former Senate president pro tempore was stripped bare. This is where Sen. Vicente “Tito” Sotto III will have to rebuild his new office as the current Senate president pro tempore. Sotto, in a message to the Inquirer on Monday, confirmed that this was indeed the condition of the office when it was turned over to them. READ: Sotto elected as Senate president pro tempore; committee heads named According to lawyer Marian Lucinario from Sotto’s office, they were “shocked” when they saw the condition of the office.
